title: clb-8k_20200717.htm
主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.01 per share for the third quarter of 2020. The dividend will be paid on August 10, 2020, to shareholders of record on July 27, 2020. A Dutch withholding tax of 15% will apply. The company, a leading provider of proprietary and patented reservoir description and production enhancement services, stated that future dividends depend on its financial position, earnings, earnings outlook, capital expenditure plans, ongoing share repurchases, potential acquisition opportunities, and other relevant factors. The company's outlook is subject to risks related to the oil and natural gas industry, business conditions, international markets, and political climates.
